_doc: Written by Claude after reviewing the footage. Segments are chronological; from/to are file names (inclusive, in capture-time order). weight = share of runtime. title=true shows a location title on the segment's first shot; new_city=true marks a city change (cinematic card). keep_whole=true uses every clip whole (e.g. aerial clips with landmark callouts). dedupe < 0.92 removes more look-alike shots (forests, gardens).
